mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0 over 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown across manufacturing and construction sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of triggered instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0 over 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of periods when PAYEMS is rising (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0 over 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500,000 units signals a contraction in the housing sector and a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 500.0 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a deep recession.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of triggered instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100.0), industrial production contraction signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0 over 10-year rolling window).
